name: Airia
source:
Her youth spent earning money as a prostitute while striving to return to her homeland.
For over a decade, she wandered as a prostitute and came to master the skills needed to survive.
Because of that, her personality has changed—compared to her naive childhood, she now sees things with calm discernment.
During her journey, she [spoiler]experiences pregnancy and childbirth, becoming a mother, but feeling she cannot be with her child in her current state, she parts ways with them.
When she learns that her homeland has been destroyed, she is overwhelmed by despair.
Even so, she manages to rise again, and together with her reunited daughter, sets her sights on restoring their fallen homeland.[/spoiler]
